notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the LEFT, east is UP. East McMillan runs sheet-vertical at x~980-1040 (slightly tilted), Auburn Av along the top, Hollister sheet-vertical at x~2930-3070 on the right, Vine diagonal across the bottom-left. Printed names: 'AUBURN AV.', 'E. McMILLAN', 'MACAULEY (SYCAMORE)' (old name Sycamore, shown as Sycamore on the key map), 'GUILFORD (ROBERTA)' (old name Roberta), 'HOLLISTER', 'VINE'; names without a suffix written with 'Street'. McMillan changes from East McMillan to West McMillan at Vine (key map W./E. split at Vine), so the Vine crossing is recorded under both names; West McMillan is not labelled on this sheet. Auburn changes direction at the McMillan crossing itself: south of McMillan it runs sheet-horizontal, north of it the diagonal runs lower-left off the sheet (no separate bend point). The diagonal street running lower-left from the Auburn/McMillan junction is unlabelled here (presumed Auburn Avenue north of McMillan, per key map). Auburn/McMillan centre: Auburn south line y~504, north line y~293 at x~1060 (60'), McMillan lines x~897/1067. Hollister/Auburn: Auburn centre from the south block line (y~343 at x 3067) minus half the 60' width; Auburn's north line is off the top of the paper. Vine/Hollister centre (~2932, ~4715) is below the paper edge (paper ends ~y 4580), not recorded; Hollister runs off the bottom. The large 'WAVERLY' lettering along McMillan at y~3200 is a building name, not a street. No alleys on this sheet.
